The staged 2.0.x source contains the same missing coefficient-range checks in `encode_one_block()`, so the anchors below use the exact `/src/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x` line map from the reproduced image.

classification.classification_note: MemorySanitizer reports the executing macro call site at `jchuff.c:594:3`, but the actual one-byte uninitialized read is `size = actbl->ehufsi[temp3];` after the derived AC symbol index overflows to 256.

bug_description.original_source: sample_info.json issue_description / patch.diff / sanitizer_trace.txt / staged /src/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x source snapshot
bug_description.normalized: The staged witness is a 116-byte malformed progressive arithmetic JPEG: it begins `ff d8 ff ca`, so `get_sof()` marks the source image as progressive arithmetic, and its only SOS body is `01 20 20 10 2c 06`, which makes `start_pass()` select `decode_mcu_AC_first()` with `Ss=16`, `Se=44`, `Ah=0`, and `Al=6`. The saved crash stack identifies the executed output path as the third `tjTransform()` call at `fuzz/transform.cc:129:7`, where the harness has already selected `TJXOP_ROT90 | TJXOPT_TRIM`. Before decoding coefficients, `jtransform_request_workspace()` allocates transposed workspace arrays for that rotated output. During `jpeg_read_coefficients()`, `consume_data()` aliases `coef->whole_image` blocks into `coef->MCU_buffer`, and the arithmetic decoder stores a malformed nonzero AC coefficient into those source coefficient arrays. On the third transform call's output side, `jpeg_copy_critical_parameters()` reinitializes the destination compressor for default baseline Huffman coding, `jtransform_adjust_parameters()` returns the rotated workspace arrays as the destination coefficient buffer, `jpeg_write_coefficients()` registers those arrays with the compression-side coefficient controller, and `jtransform_execute_transformation()` / `do_rot_90()` copies the malformed source coefficient into a rotated destination block while preserving its absolute magnitude even if the sign flips. `start_pass_huff()` then derives a 256-entry AC table, `compress_output()` feeds the rotated destination block into `encode_one_block()`, and vulnerable code computes `nbits = JPEG_NBITS_NONZERO(temp)` for the transformed coefficient without checking `nbits <= MAX_COEF_BITS`. Because the same destination block reaches a `kloop(...)` instance on source line 594 after a zero run of 15, `temp3 = (r << 4) + nbits` becomes 256, and `size = actbl->ehufsi[temp3]` reads one byte past the 256-entry table. MemorySanitizer reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` in `encode_one_block` and traces the adjacent byte back to the image-memory pool allocation chain rooted at `jinit_c_master_control()`. The staged patch resolves the executed obligation by restoring coefficient-range checks after both DC and AC `nbits` computations so out-of-range coefficients raise `JERR_BAD_DCT_COEF` before any table lookup.

source.var: cinfo->progressive_mode, cinfo->arith_code, cinfo->data_precision, cinfo->image_height, cinfo->image_width, cinfo->num_components
source.description: First project-side materialization of the SOF10 frame header. The staged witness starts with `ff d8 ff ca`, so `get_sof(..., TRUE, TRUE)` marks the source JPEG as progressive arithmetic and reads the frame precision, dimensions, and component count that the arithmetic decode path and the later transform workspace sizing both consume.
source.value_from: The exact staged `poc` is a 116-byte file with SHA-256 `4550c948be42c5045d2aca78f6c45dbe26b3838e148fd5a8e4d1d6c215a69fd4`. Its JPEG markers are `SOI`, `SOF10(len=20, body=0801200d2004202200201100201100202200)`, `DQT(len=67, body=0020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020ff2020ff20202020202020202020202020202020ff202020202020202020)`, and `SOS(len=8, body=012020102c06)` followed by 13 entropy-coded bytes. The `ff ca` marker supplies `is_prog = TRUE` and `is_arith = TRUE`, and the SOF10 body materializes `data_precision = 8`, `image_height = 0x0120`, `image_width = 0x0d20`, and `num_components = 4` at this source step.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

root_cause.description: Root cause. The vulnerable C Huffman encoder computes the bit width of a nonzero AC coefficient from the rotated destination block but never checks that the width stays within `MAX_COEF_BITS` before combining it with the zero run into a Huffman symbol index. For the witnessed transformed coefficient, this missing guard lets `nbits` reach 16 and eventually yields symbol 256.
root_cause.note: The staged patch restores the missing obligation immediately after this assignment by adding `if (nbits > MAX_COEF_BITS) ERREXIT(..., JERR_BAD_DCT_COEF);` on the AC path (and an analogous check on the DC path).

sink.description: MSAN sink. Once the derived AC symbol for the rotated destination block becomes 256, this read indexes one byte past the 256-entry `ehufsi` table and consumes adjacent image-pool bytes that were never initialized as table data.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports the executing macro call site as `encode_one_block /src/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x/jchuff.c:594:3`, which is the line containing the six `kloop(...)` invocations that all expand to this same `ehufsi[temp3]` read. Runtime disambiguation is disabled for this sample, so Stage 02 keeps the sink anchored at the shared line-584 read performed by that line-594 macro group.

tainted_value_origin.description: This arithmetic-decoder store is where the entropy-coded scan data becomes the malformed `JCOEF` later copied by `do_rot_90()` into the rotated destination arrays that baseline Huffman output encodes. Because `consume_data()` has already aliased `MCU_data[0]` to `coef->whole_image`, the stored coefficient persists in the virtual arrays returned by `jpeg_read_coefficients()`.

parser_admitted.description: The staged SOS body `01 20 20 10 2c 06` parses as a one-component progressive arithmetic AC-first scan with `Ss=16`, `Se=44`, `Ah=0`, and `Al=6`. Those parameters pass `start_pass()` validation and route the file into `decode_mcu_AC_first()` rather than the DC-first or refinement paths.

evidence_limitations: Stage 01 reproduced against the staged `/src/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x` source tree inside the vulnerable image, not against a checked-out `2.1.x` worktree. The metadata commits and `patch.diff` still describe the same missing coefficient-range checks, but the exact line anchors below follow the staged 2.0.x source snapshot named in the sanitizer trace.

The saved runtime stack resolves the crashing harness edge to the third `tjTransform()` call at `fuzz/transform.cc:129:7`, where `transforms[0]` has already been set to `TJXOP_ROT90 | TJXOPT_TRIM` at lines 121-122. No broader ambiguity among the later `tjTransform()` calls remains.

The saved stack reports only the shared macro call site `jchuff.c:594:3`, which covers six `kloop(...)` invocations. With `run_flags.json` leaving `runtime_disambiguation` disabled, Stage 02 does not distinguish which of those six transformed destination coefficients fired; the trace therefore grounds the sink at the common `ehufsi[temp3]` read and relies on source semantics plus `temp3 = 256` to derive the immediate zero run of 15.
Stage 02 did not execute fixed-side runtime validation. `patch_resolves = true` below is source-grounded from the staged diff restoring the missing coefficient-range checks before the table lookup.

fine_trace.var: cinfo->progressive_mode, cinfo->arith_code, cinfo->data_precision, cinfo->image_height, cinfo->image_width, cinfo->num_components
fine_trace.note: Source. The staged witness starts with `ff d8 ff ca`, so `get_sof(..., TRUE, TRUE)` both stores progressive-arithmetic dispatch state and materializes `data_precision = 8`, `image_height = 0x0120`, `image_width = 0x0d20`, and `num_components = 4` from the SOF10 body. Those frame fields size the later transform workspace, while the mode flags steer `jpeg_read_coefficients()` into the arithmetic decoder path used by the bug.

fine_trace.var: cinfo->comps_in_scan, cinfo->cur_comp_info[0], cinfo->Ss, cinfo->Se, cinfo->Ah, cinfo->Al
fine_trace.note: The only SOS body is `01 20 20 10 2c 06`, so `get_sos()` records a one-component scan with selector `0x20`, tables DC=2/AC=0, `Ss=16`, `Se=44`, `Ah=0`, and `Al=6`. Those scan parameters are the state later consumed by `start_pass()` and by the coefficient-scaling store in `decode_mcu_AC_first()`.

Before coefficient decoding begins, the saved stack's frame 5 shows the crashing path is the third `tjTransform()` call at `fuzz/transform.cc:129`, whose caller has already set `TJXOP_ROT90 | TJXOPT_TRIM` at lines 121-122. For that transform, `jtransform_request_workspace()` allocates transposed `workspace_coef_arrays`, so the later output path has separate rotated destination buffers available instead of re-encoding `srccoefs` in place.

Parser-admitted checkpoint. Because step 1 made the image progressive arithmetic and step 2 set `Ah=0` with `Ss=16`, `start_pass()` selects `decode_mcu_AC_first()` rather than the DC-first or refinement arms.

While `jpeg_read_coefficients()` is absorbing the scan, `consume_data()` maps the current `coef->whole_image` rows and stores direct block pointers into `coef->MCU_buffer`. The arithmetic decoder will therefore write coefficient values straight into the persistent source virtual arrays rather than into a scratch copy.

Tainted-value origin. On the witnessed path, `decode_mcu_AC_first()` materializes a malformed nonzero AC coefficient and stores it through step 5's alias into `coef->whole_image`. The arithmetic decoder simply shifts the decoded signed magnitude by `Al=6` and truncates it to `JCOEF`; it does not enforce the later baseline-Huffman `MAX_COEF_BITS` bound.

fine_trace.var: dstinfo->image_width, dstinfo->image_height, dstinfo->input_components, dstinfo->data_precision, dstinfo->dc_huff_tbl_ptrs, dstinfo->ac_huff_tbl_ptrs, dstinfo->arith_code
fine_trace.note: Output-side reinitialization checkpoint. On the same third transform call, `jpeg_copy_critical_parameters()` copies the source frame shape, component count, and precision into `dstinfo`, and `jpeg_set_defaults(dstinfo)` is the point where the output side switches away from arithmetic coding and back to default baseline Huffman tables before any coefficient writeout.

After step 7 has reinitialized the destination compressor, `jtransform_adjust_parameters()` returns step 3's workspace arrays as `dstcoefs` instead of returning `srccoefs`. Earlier in the same function, the `JXFORM_ROT_90` arm also transposes the destination parameters, so these arrays represent the rotated output image.

When `jpeg_write_coefficients(cinfo, dstcoefs)` runs on the third transform call, the compression-side coefficient controller saves step 8's returned workspace arrays as `coef->whole_image`. That is the destination coefficient buffer that `compress_output()` later walks.

This is the actual source-to-destination coefficient transfer. `do_rot_90()` fills step 8's workspace arrays by transposing source coefficients and negating every other source row in the mirrorable area. The out-of-range coefficient from step 6 is therefore materialized in a rotated destination block with the same absolute magnitude even if the sign flips.

On the baseline-Huffman output path created by step 7, `start_pass_huff()` derives the active AC table. `jpeg_make_c_derived_tbl()` allocates a `c_derived_tbl` when needed, zeros `ehufco[256]` and `ehufsi[256]`, and populates only symbols 0..255, so symbol 256 is out of range by construction.

During `jpeg_finish_compress()`, `compress_output()` maps the encoder-side `coef->whole_image` from step 9 and hands block pointers from the rotated destination arrays to `encode_mcu_huff()` / `encode_one_block()`. This is the output-side alias that reconnects the transformed destination block to the sink.

Root cause. When the rotated destination block from step 12 reaches the C Huffman encoder, the transformed out-of-range coefficient from step 10 becomes `temp`. Because step 10 preserved absolute magnitude, `JPEG_NBITS_NONZERO(temp)` can still return 16 here, and vulnerable code does not reject `nbits > MAX_COEF_BITS`.

Repeated executions of this zero branch on the same transformed destination block increment `r` once per zero immediately before the bad coefficient. The saved stack narrows the crashing coefficient only to the line-594 macro group, but whichever one of those six `kloop(...)` arms fires, the destination zigzag walk has accumulated a 15-zero run at that point.

This combines the zero run and coefficient width into the AC symbol index. Because step 14 has already left `r = 15` and step 13 allowed `nbits = 16`, the overflowing value here is `temp3 = 256`, one past the legal AC symbol range 0..255.

Sink. `actbl->ehufsi` has 256 entries, so step 15's `temp3 = 256` reads one byte past the table into adjacent image-pool storage and produces the observed `use-of-uninitialized-value`. MemorySanitizer reports the corresponding macro call site at `jchuff.c:594:3` because this line executes inside the unrolled `kloop(...)` expansion group on that source line.

allocation_context.note: The saved MSan origin stack traces the poisoned byte to the image-memory pool allocation rooted here. That is consistent with step 16 reading one byte past `ehufsi[255]` into neighboring pool storage rather than into a separately initialized table element.

sanitizer_ground_truth.patch_resolves_note: The staged diff restores coefficient-range checks after both DC and AC `nbits` computations in `encode_one_block()`. The witnessed path here is the AC hunk: it rejects out-of-range coefficients before `temp3` can become 256 and before `ehufsi[temp3]` is read.

cross_validation.sink_matches_crash: Yes. MemorySanitizer reports the `kloop(...)` invocation group at `jchuff.c:594:3`; each invocation expands to the same fine-trace sink read `size = actbl->ehufsi[temp3];` at line 584.
cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: Partially. The project root cause is the missing `MAX_COEF_BITS` guard at step 13, while the MSan origin points to the adjacent image-memory pool allocation because step 16 reads one byte past the 256-entry `ehufsi` table into neighboring pool storage allocated during compression setup.
cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes. The saved stack lands in `encode_one_block -> encode_mcu_huff -> compress_output -> jpeg_finish_compress -> tjTransform -> LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput@fuzz/transform.cc:129`, and steps 3 and 7-16 expand the third `TJXOP_ROT90 | TJXOPT_TRIM` transform's output-side workspace, copy, and encode path while steps 1-2 and 4-6 explain how the malformed arithmetic coefficient was created in the source arrays.
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Yes. Step 6 stores the malformed AC coefficient into the source `coef->whole_image`, step 8 routes the third transform's output to dedicated workspace arrays, step 10 copies the coefficient into the rotated destination block, step 12 passes that destination block to `encode_one_block()`, step 13 makes `nbits = 16`, step 15 derives `temp3 = 256`, and step 16 consumes that derived index in `actbl->ehufsi[temp3]`.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's saved vulnerable-workspace run reproduced `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` in `encode_one_block` with stack `encode_one_block -> encode_mcu_huff -> compress_output`. The saved stack further pins the executed path to the third `tjTransform()` call at `fuzz/transform.cc:129`, matching `reproduction_report.json`, `sanitizer_trace.txt`, and `default_crash_trace.txt` for the staged `poc`.

format.name: Exact staged SOF10 arithmetic JPEG witness
format.contract: Only the exact 116-byte file staged at `gt_results/arvo_60253/poc` with SHA-256 `4550c948be42c5045d2aca78f6c45dbe26b3838e148fd5a8e4d1d6c215a69fd4` is claimed. Its verified trigger semantics are the exact marker/layout combination observed in Stage 02: `SOF10(len=20, body=0801200d2004202200201100201100202200)` sets progressive arithmetic mode, the single `SOS(len=8, body=012020102c06)` makes the decoder take the arithmetic AC-first path with `Ss=16`, `Se=44`, `Ah=0`, and `Al=6`, and the remaining 13 entropy-coded bytes create a stored coefficient that, on the third `tjTransform()` call configured as `TJXOP_ROT90 | TJXOPT_TRIM`, is copied into rotated destination workspace arrays and later drives the baseline-Huffman AC symbol index to 256. No broader class of arithmetic JPEGs, scan headers, transform modes, or coefficient ranges is claimed.
